fields.headline: Accepts up to $333,791 from Alameda County for Safe Routes to School, October 2018 through June 2021
fields.summary: This amends the district's master contract with the County of Alameda's Health Care Services Agency by adding a set of exhibits for the Active Oakland Safe Routes to School program. The County pays the district up to $333,791 for October 1, 2018 through June 30, 2021. The attached cover sheet marks this as an original procurement contract, so the $333,791 is the full amount for the period, not an increase. All other terms stay the same.

20-2406.note: Corrected: the attached contract shows Alameda County pays the District up to $333,791 for this program, not the District paying the County. The amount is the full total for the contract period, not an increase.
20-2406.sourceIssue: The text gives a single not-to-exceed amount of $333,791.00 for an amendment to a contract running from October 1, 2018, without saying whether this is added money or the contract's total.
